owner_id.title: Owner Player ID (Optional)
owner_id.description: Leave empty to start without an assigned owner; copy your Player ID from the bottom of the in-game Settings menu to enable owner permissions after a restart (not Steam64).

server_name.title: Server Name
server_name.description: Public session name; the server truncates it to 15 characters.

default_world_name.title: New World Name
default_world_name.description: Name used to create a new default world. The save-slot name is limited to 15 characters.

admin_password.title: Admin Password
admin_password.description: Players who know this password can open the in-game Server Management screen as administrators.

platform_policy.title: Allowed Platforms
platform_policy.description: Keep native setting preserves the existing platform restriction. If the native setting is absent, the server allows crossplay. Choose a platform policy explicitly to change it, then restart the server.

world_password.title: Join Password
world_password.description: Leave empty to allow joining without a password.

extra_launch_args.title: Extra Launch Arguments
extra_launch_args.description: Optional raw launch arguments. LanGame already passes -Port and -QueryPort from the managed ports. Add -log -NewConsole here only when a separate official console window is desired.
